meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Also covers Tailwind projects and the STORYBOARD.md / SCRIPT.md plan formats. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作按时间轴编排的可渲染视觉
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望通过代码和 HTML 亲手制作动态影像作品
copy.tagline_en: Create renderable visual scenes timed by code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to craft dynamic animations with code and HTML.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范构建视频项目:用 HTML 描述画面,以 data-* 属性设定时间轴,安排片段轨道和子合成,并遵守固定渲染规则。
howto.when: 当你要求做 HyperFrames 合成项目,或涉及时间轴属性、片段轨道、媒体播放、校验等场景时触发;也可用于 Tailwind 项目及 STORYBOARD/SCRIPT 计划。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 HyperFrames 项目,含一个3秒的标题片段。
say.note: Claude 会生成可渲染的项目骨架。

say.text: 给这个合成设置 data-start='0',再加一个从第2秒开始的子合成。
say.note: Claude 会按规范配置时间轴和子合成。

say.text: 用 hyperframes check 校验这个 index.html。
say.note: Claude 会运行校验并报告问题。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude builds HyperFrames compositions: HTML files describing scenes, with data-* timing, tracks, sub-compositions, and deterministic-render rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a HyperFrames composition, or when dealing with timing attributes, tracks, media playback, validation, Tailwind projects, or STORYBOARD/SCRIPT plans.

say_en.text: Create a new HyperFrames project with a 3-second title clip.
say_en.note: Claude will scaffold a renderable project.

say_en.text: Set data-start='0' on this composition and add a sub-composition starting at second 2.
say_en.note: Claude will configure the timeline accordingly.

say_en.text: Run hyperframes check on this index.html.
say_en.note: Claude will validate and report findings.
